use_case: Face verification (1:1) add-on in the city's cloud access control tenant at the city hall staff entrance: a camera reader checks that the face matches the enrolled template of the badge presented. The city facilities manager asked the owner to configure it; the vendor trial is on in the tenant until 2026-10-31
business_owner: City (system owner and decision-maker); the owner would configure and operate it
vendor_or_model: Access control SaaS vendor (the city's vendor); machine learning face matching module, trial license; 2 loaned camera readers
build_or_buy: Configure (third-party feature in a customer system)
data_categories: Face images and face templates (treated as biometric data); badge ID; match scores; access events of about 85 city hall staff
human_in_the_loop: Designed as a second factor only: badge always required; a failed match falls back to badge plus PIN or the reception desk; no one is refused entry or disciplined on a match result alone
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 (biometric data; status of templates unsettled, counsel to confirm); Fla. Stat. 119.071(5)(g) (biometric exemption covers fingerprints and similar records only) and 119.0701(2)(b); city contract security exhibit; Florida Digital Bill of Rights does not apply (controller test not met)
status: Proposed (not configured; no staff enrolled; owner declines to configure until the P10 conditions are met)

use_case: Consumer generative AI chatbot (SYS-07) used to troubleshoot BAS control logic and draft monthly reports
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI chatbot provider (free plan); model-improvement setting off since 2026-08-12
data_categories: General technical questions and text the owner writes; no customer data allowed (city point lists and a door schedule excerpt were entered June to August 2026)
human_in_the_loop: The owner checks every suggestion against the manufacturer documentation and the city's sequence of operations before any change, and every change still needs the city facilities manager's approval; report drafts are rewritten by the owner
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 119.071(3) (exempt building and security system information must not be entered); city contract (data only in approved services)
status: In production with limits (no customer data; POL-01 9.6)
